text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One effective method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This framework helps teams stay focused and track their progress. Breaking a project into smaller milestones makes it easier to monitor development and celebrate achievements along the way. It is also important to define clear deliverables so everyone understands what the final results should look like. Finally, stakeholder alignment ensures that everyone involved shares the same expectations and supports the project's direction. When these elements are in place, projects are more likely to succeed.
